Alex: ACME PM asked for a version freeze on driver/CUDA/ROCm for their marketplace image before next Wed announcement. They want a compat matrix + hotfix playbook.
Maria: OK. Do they insist on CUDA 12.3 or is 12.2 fine?
Alex: They said 12.x but flagged a perf note on 12.3. Asking for our recommendation.
Zheng: Quick test: A100 long-context shows ~+15% p50 on 12.3+535 vs 12.2+520. Recommend 12.2 + driver 520 for GA.
Sam: I'll draft rollback steps and exact pin commands (kernel + driver).
Nina: Compliance wants a signed PDF matrix and a one-page hotfix playbook. Can we deliver by Fri EOD?
Maria: I can draft the matrix and partner blurb. Alex, can you run a canary?
Alex: Kicking canary now. @OpsBot please start canary-5098765432.
OpsBot: Canary queued: canary-5098765432 on (staging,dedicated). ETA ~30m.
Zheng: I'll attach minimal repro and telemetry thresholds to the doc.
Sam: Suggest publishing stable image tag `redwood/runtime:cuda12.2-driver520-stable` and an experimental `cuda12.3-driver535-exp`.
Maria: Action list: Maria -> matrix + comms (Fri); Alex -> canary results (today); Sam -> rollback/playbook (tomorrow); Zheng -> repro + thresholds (today); Nina -> partner signoff.
Nina: I'll confirm acceptance with ACME and loop PM/legal.
Alex: If all green we sign the matrix and publish the pinned image.
Nina: Thanks team. I'll post partner signoff update here.
